The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 23 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the river value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
